obligations.title: Process Client Personal Data only for the Services, on documented instructions or as required by law.
Tell the Client promptly if an instruction appears to infringe data protection law.
Bind all persons authorised to process Client Personal Data to confidentiality duties.
Implement and maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures.
Assist the Client with Data Subject requests, security, breach notification and impact assessments.
Maintain records of processing activities as required by data protection law.
Notify the Client without undue delay of any Data Subject or regulator request or complaint.
Give the Client prior written notice of any intended Sub-processor addition or replacement.
Impose written obligations no less protective than the DPA on each Sub-processor.
Do not transfer or permit access to Client Personal Data outside Singapore except as instructed and lawful.
Ensure any permitted transfer recipient is bound by comparable-protection safeguards.
Notify the Client without undue delay of a Personal Data Breach, with the required details.
Contain and remediate a breach and cooperate with the Client's investigation.
Return or securely delete all Client Personal Data on expiry, termination or Client request.
Confirm deletion of Client Personal Data in writing on request.
Keep the other party's confidential information confidential and use it only for the Agreement.
